evidence: Col. 1.5: cum veterī adstruitur recēns aedificium (Lewis & Short s.v. astruō)
terms.comment: The participle of Columella’s expression for a new building added to an old one; adstruere is to build on in addition (also Plin. Ep. 9.7, of his villas). Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for an extension.

sources: The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.

phrases.english: the new wing, built on to the old house
